item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure Data Share will be retired on November 12, 2029
item.description:
Azure Data Share is scheduled for retirement on November 12, 2029. Users should migrate data sharing workloads to Microsoft Fabric or another appropriate source-specific sharing option before that date.

  • Source: Azure Updates
